name: pixivbiu-1d7c9790-blind30-ots
instr:
# A self-hosted illustration companion app misbehaving everywhere, to be repaired without a test suite

Working with this build has become an exercise in distrust: a great many ordinary operations come back with the wrong answer, and a few fail outright. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I could pin down by using the program, in the order I ran into it.

Getting signed in is the first thing that breaks. Asking the program to begin a browser sign-in hands back an error rather than a fresh handshake value, so no sign-in can be begun at all and there is nothing to open in a browser. The web address meant for that browser step is malformed too: the query parameters are glued straight onto the sign-in page address with no question mark between them, so the address and the first parameter run together. When more sign-in attempts are pending at once than the small in-memory limit allows, the wrong one is thrown out — after a fourth attempt against a limit of three, the earliest attempt is still redeemable, which is not what trimming to capacity should leave behind.

Staying signed in across relaunches goes wrong as well. With a credential that stays good for another half hour, bringing the program up again nonetheless makes a renewal round trip to the remote site and swaps out the credential that was already fine. The standalone judgement behind that decision leans the same way: a session whose access credential is good for thirty
